ValidationRule.description: SS-2739 - Validate the compliance framework values and enforce when they need to be completed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((TEXT(Server_Device_Type__c) = "Tanium Cloud for U.S. Government" && TEXT(Compliance_Framework__c) != "tc_usg") || (TEXT(Server_Device_Type__c) != "Tanium Cloud for U.S. Government" && TEXT(Compliance_Framework__c) = "tc_usg")) && NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Compliance Framework must be set to "tc_usg" if the License Key Function is "Tanium Cloud for U.S. Government.
